noBranch: Select a branch from the switcher above to manage its academic structure.

years.title: Academic years
years.subtitle: Manage academic years and their semesters
years.createDescription: Pick how many semesters the year runs — they are created for you.
years.name: Year name
years.empty: No academic years yet. Add the first one.
years.statusChangeFailed: Could not change the year's status.
years.statusConfirmActive: {name} becomes the operating year — new enrollments and fees anchor to it. The changes below take effect immediately.
years.termsCountHint: They are created automatically — you can rename them, set dates, or add more later (max 5).
years.activeHint: The active year is the branch's operating year — the previous active year completes automatically.
years.nameAutoHint: Auto-filled from the start date's Ethiopian year — edit it if you prefer another name.

terms.title: Semesters
terms.name: Name
terms.pageSubtitle: Every semester and quarter across your academic years
terms.programWillBeAdded: This branch doesn't run this program yet — saving will add it to the branch's settings.
terms.isQuarterHint: Mark shorter grading periods (quarters) apart from full semesters.
terms.semesterHint: Groups this quarter under a semester for yearly roster averages.
terms.scheduleHint: Daily class window and how many minutes one period takes.
terms.empty: No semesters yet. Add an academic year first, or add one here.
terms.statusChangeFailed: Could not change the semester status.
terms.confirmActivate: Activate {name}? All new attendance, grades and fee records will anchor to it.
terms.confirmActivateWithSiblings: Activate {name}? {siblings} — currently active for {program} — will be CLOSED and become read-only. All new attendance, grades and fee records will anchor to {name}.
terms.confirmClose: Close {name}? Every record anchored to it (attendance, grades, assessments) becomes read-only. You can reopen it later if needed.
terms.confirmReopen: Reopen {name} as planned? Its records become editable again. Activate it explicitly if it should be the running semester.
terms.autoGenerateWarning: The system will pre-build the teaching grid from the curriculum and each teacher's declared subjects. Double-check the result and adjust teachers where needed — ambiguous slots are left unassigned on purpose.
terms.cloneDescription: Creates a new semester with the same program and schedule settings, and copies its section → subject → teacher assignments.
terms.copyDescription: Pulls another semester's section → subject → teacher grid into this one. Existing pairs are left untouched; teachers who are no longer active copy as unassigned.
terms.copyForceTitle: Nothing new to copy — replace instead?
terms.copyForceDesc: Every section × subject already exists on {name}. Replace its teacher assignments with the ones from {source}? Rows you assigned manually will be overwritten.

sections.title: Sections
sections.subtitle: Manage class sections per grade level
sections.name: Section name
sections.empty: No sections yet. Add the first one.
sections.homeroomHint: Homerooms are per academic year and can only be employees with an active teacher position.
sections.homeroomConfirmDesc: {teacher} becomes the homeroom teacher of {name} for the selected academic year.
sections.homeroomClearDesc: {name} will have no homeroom teacher for the selected academic year.
sections.statusActivateDesc: {name} becomes active — it appears in enrollment, attendance and semester grids again.
sections.statusDeactivateDesc: {name} becomes inactive — it is hidden from enrollment and new semester grids. Existing records are kept.

profile.subtitle: Class roster and semester performance
profile.empty: No students on this class list for the selected semester.

matrix.noSubjects: No subjects yet — add one or use auto-generate.
matrix.noSections: No sections in this branch yet
matrix.noSectionsDescription: Create sections first — the teaching grid is built per section.
matrix.generateConfirmDescription: One row is created for every section × subject in its grade's curriculum. A teacher is pre-filled only when exactly one teacher declares that subject & grade — everything else stays unassigned for you to decide. Existing rows are never touched. Note: only grades that HAVE sections are covered — create the other grades' sections first if they are missing.
matrix.closedNotice: {name} is closed — its assignments are read-only.
matrix.applyToAllDesc: The same subject is still unassigned in {count} more sections of this grade.
matrix.loadApplyDesc: {count} more sections of this grade have a different number.

assign.subtitle: Distribute students of a grade into balanced sections, then confirm.
assign.noBranch: Select a branch to assign sections.
assign.unplacedWarning: {count} students could not be placed — all sections are full.
